_note: Sửa lỗi sai: mỗi chủ điểm 10 câu có đúng một lỗi kiểu người Việt hay mắc (lấy từ các lỗi trong bài kiểm tra và bài viết). Người học viết lại cả câu cho đúng; en là các cách sửa được chấp nhận, why_vi giải thích lỗi.

nouns-articles.wrong: Many student in my class want to study abroad.
en: Many students in my class want to study abroad.
nouns-articles.why_vi: many + danh từ đếm được số nhiều → students.

nouns-articles.wrong: She is teacher at a primary school.
en: She is a teacher at a primary school.
nouns-articles.why_vi: Danh từ đếm được số ít chỉ nghề nghiệp cần a/an: a teacher.

nouns-articles.wrong: There are a lot of informations on the internet.
en: There is a lot of information on the internet.
There is much information on the internet.
nouns-articles.why_vi: information là danh từ không đếm được: không thêm -s, động từ chia số ít (there is).

nouns-articles.wrong: The children need more homeworks after school.
en: The children need more homework after school.
nouns-articles.why_vi: homework không đếm được → không có -s.

nouns-articles.wrong: Government should invest more money in public transport.
en: The government should invest more money in public transport.
Governments should invest more money in public transport.
nouns-articles.why_vi: government là danh từ đếm được: cần the (chính phủ cụ thể) hoặc dùng số nhiều governments.

nouns-articles.wrong: I bought an useful book yesterday.
en: I bought a useful book yesterday.
nouns-articles.why_vi: useful đọc /juː/ (âm phụ âm) → dùng a, không dùng an.

nouns-articles.wrong: The money are not the most important thing in life.
en: Money is not the most important thing in life.
nouns-articles.why_vi: Nói chung chung về tiền thì không dùng the; money không đếm được → is.

nouns-articles.wrong: Two of my friend work in a bank.
en: Two of my friends work in a bank.
nouns-articles.why_vi: one / two / some of + danh từ số nhiều: of my friends.

nouns-articles.wrong: Most of people prefer living in the city.
en: Most people prefer living in the city.
Most of the people prefer living in the city.
nouns-articles.why_vi: most + danh từ (nói chung), hoặc most of + the / my… + danh từ. Không nói most of people.

nouns-articles.wrong: Every students must wear a uniform.
en: Every student must wear a uniform.
All students must wear a uniform.
All students must wear uniforms.
nouns-articles.why_vi: every + danh từ số ít (every student); muốn số nhiều thì dùng all students.

agreement.wrong: My brother work in a hospital.
en: My brother works in a hospital.
agreement.why_vi: Chủ ngữ số ít (my brother) → động từ hiện tại đơn thêm -s: works.

agreement.wrong: The number of tourists have increased.
en: The number of tourists has increased.
agreement.why_vi: Chủ ngữ chính là the number (số ít) → has. (A number of tourists + have.)

agreement.wrong: Everyone in my family like football.
en: Everyone in my family likes football.
agreement.why_vi: everyone / everybody / each luôn đi với động từ số ít → likes.

agreement.wrong: The price of houses are rising quickly.
en: The price of houses is rising quickly.
The prices of houses are rising quickly.
agreement.why_vi: Chủ ngữ chính là the price (số ít); of houses chỉ bổ nghĩa → is.

agreement.wrong: There is many reasons for this problem.
en: There are many reasons for this problem.
agreement.why_vi: Sau there be, động từ chia theo danh từ phía sau: many reasons → are.

agreement.wrong: Reading books help children learn new words.
en: Reading books helps children learn new words.
Reading books helps children to learn new words.
agreement.why_vi: Chủ ngữ là cụm V-ing (reading books) → coi là số ít: helps.

agreement.wrong: People in this city doesn't use public transport.
en: People in this city do not use public transport.
agreement.why_vi: people là số nhiều → do not / don't, không dùng doesn't.

agreement.wrong: One of the main problems are traffic jams.
en: One of the main problems is traffic jams.
One of the main problems is traffic congestion.
agreement.why_vi: one of + danh từ số nhiều nhưng chủ ngữ là one → động từ số ít: is.

agreement.wrong: The students who lives near school walk there.
en: The students who live near school walk there.
The students who live near the school walk there.
agreement.why_vi: Trong mệnh đề quan hệ, động từ chia theo danh từ được thay thế (the students, số nhiều) → live.

en: News travels very fast nowadays.
agreement.why_vi: news tuy có -s nhưng là danh từ không đếm được, số ít → travels.

present-simple.wrong: She go to school by bus every day.
en: She goes to school by bus every day.
He does not like coffee.
present-simple.why_vi: Sau does / doesn't, động từ ở dạng nguyên mẫu: like.

present-simple.wrong: Do your father work at weekends?
en: Does your father work at weekends?
present-simple.why_vi: Câu hỏi với chủ ngữ số ít dùng does.

en: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
present-simple.why_vi: Sự thật hiển nhiên dùng hiện tại đơn; water (số ít) → boils.

present-simple.wrong: My parents usually is at home in the evening.
en: My parents are usually at home in the evening.
present-simple.why_vi: my parents số nhiều → are; trạng từ tần suất đứng SAU động từ to be.

present-simple.wrong: I am agree with this opinion.
en: I agree with this opinion.
present-simple.why_vi: agree là động từ thường, không đi với am/is/are.

present-simple.wrong: She always is late for class.
en: She is always late for class.
present-simple.why_vi: always / usually / often đứng sau to be, trước động từ thường.

en: The shop opens at 8 a.m.
The shop opens at 8 am.

present-simple.wrong: My mother watchs TV after dinner.
en: My mother watches TV after dinner.
present-simple.why_vi: Động từ tận cùng -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o thêm -es: watches.

en: He studies English every evening.
present-simple.why_vi: Phụ âm + y → đổi y thành i rồi thêm -es: studies.

past-simple.wrong: Yesterday I go to the library.
en: Yesterday I went to the library.
I went to the library yesterday.
past-simple.why_vi: Có yesterday → quá khứ đơn: go → went.

past-simple.wrong: She didn't went to work last week.
en: She did not go to work last week.
past-simple.why_vi: Sau did / didn't, động từ trở về nguyên mẫu: go.

past-simple.wrong: We buyed a new car in 2020.
en: We bought a new car in 2020.
past-simple.why_vi: buy là động từ bất quy tắc: buy → bought.

past-simple.wrong: The number of visitors rise sharply in 2015.
en: The number of visitors rose sharply in 2015.
past-simple.why_vi: Mốc thời gian quá khứ (in 2015) → rise → rose.

past-simple.wrong: When I was a child, I live in the countryside.
en: When I was a child, I lived in the countryside.
past-simple.why_vi: Cả câu nói về quá khứ → lived.

en: Did you finish your homework?
past-simple.why_vi: Câu hỏi với did + động từ nguyên mẫu: finish.

past-simple.wrong: He studyed hard for the exam.
en: He studied hard for the exam.

past-simple.wrong: They was very happy with the result.
en: They were very happy with the result.
past-simple.why_vi: they → were (I / he / she / it → was).

past-simple.wrong: Sales falled to 200 units in March.
en: Sales fell to 200 units in March.
past-simple.why_vi: fall là bất quy tắc: fall → fell → fallen.

past-simple.wrong: Two years ago, my sister has moved to Hanoi.
en: Two years ago, my sister moved to Hanoi.
My sister moved to Hanoi two years ago.
past-simple.why_vi: … ago là thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ → quá khứ đơn, không dùng hiện tại hoàn thành.

en: I have lived here since 2018.
I have been living here since 2018.
present-perfect.why_vi: since + mốc thời gian, việc kéo dài đến hiện tại → hiện tại hoàn thành: have lived.

present-perfect.wrong: She has finished her report yesterday.
en: She finished her report yesterday.
present-perfect.why_vi: yesterday là thời điểm xác định → quá khứ đơn.

present-perfect.wrong: Have you ever went to Japan?
en: Have you ever been to Japan?
Have you ever gone to Japan?
present-perfect.why_vi: have + V3 (quá khứ phân từ): go → gone / been, không dùng went.

present-perfect.wrong: The price of petrol has rose since January.
en: The price of petrol has risen since January.

present-perfect.wrong: We have known each other for 2015.
en: We have known each other since 2015.
present-perfect.why_vi: Mốc thời gian (2015) dùng since; khoảng thời gian (ten years) mới dùng for.

en: He has not eaten anything today.

present-perfect.wrong: My father has worked in this company since ten years.
en: My father has worked in this company for ten years.
My father has worked at this company for ten years.
present-perfect.why_vi: ten years là khoảng thời gian → for.

en: Technology has changed our lives.
present-perfect.why_vi: technology (không đếm được, số ít) → has.

present-perfect.wrong: I already have done my homework.
en: I have already done my homework.
present-perfect.why_vi: already đứng giữa have và V3.

present-perfect.wrong: Unemployment has decrease in recent years.
en: Unemployment has decreased in recent years.

future.wrong: I think it will rains tomorrow.
en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
future.why_vi: will + động từ nguyên mẫu, không thêm -s.

future.wrong: The population is expected reaching 10 million by 2030.
en: The population is expected to reach 10 million by 2030.
future.why_vi: be expected + to V: is expected to reach.

future.wrong: Next year I am going study in Australia.
en: Next year I am going to study in Australia.
I am going to study in Australia next year.
future.why_vi: be going + to V: am going to study.

future.wrong: If the trend continues, sales will to increase.
en: If the trend continues, sales will increase.

future.wrong: When I will finish university, I will look for a job.
en: When I finish university, I will look for a job.
future.why_vi: Sau when / before / after / as soon as dùng hiện tại đơn để nói về tương lai.

future.wrong: She will not comes to the party.
en: She will not come to the party.
future.why_vi: will not + V nguyên mẫu: come.

future.wrong: By 2040, the number of cars is predicted to doubles.
en: By 2040, the number of cars is predicted to double.
future.why_vi: to + động từ nguyên mẫu: to double.

future.wrong: Will you to help me with this project?
en: Will you help me with this project?
future.why_vi: Câu hỏi: Will + S + V nguyên mẫu, không có to.

future.wrong: Experts predict that robots replace many jobs in the future.
en: Experts predict that robots will replace many jobs in the future.
future.why_vi: Dự đoán về tương lai cần will: will replace.

future.wrong: The new bridge is going to opened next month.
en: The new bridge is going to open next month.
The new bridge is going to be opened next month.
future.why_vi: going to + V nguyên mẫu (open), hoặc bị động going to be + V3 (be opened).

passive.wrong: English is speak in many countries.
en: English is spoken in many countries.
passive.why_vi: Bị động: be + V3. speak → spoken.

passive.wrong: The students were learned grammar by the teacher.
en: The students were taught grammar by the teacher.
Grammar was taught to the students by the teacher.
passive.why_vi: learn là tự mình học; người khác dạy cho mình là teach → be taught.

en: This house was built in 1990.

passive.wrong: Plastic bags should banned in supermarkets.
en: Plastic bags should be banned in supermarkets.
passive.why_vi: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: should + be + V3.

passive.wrong: A new hospital is being build in my town.
en: A new hospital is being built in my town.
passive.why_vi: is being + V3 (bị động tiếp diễn): built.

passive.wrong: The accident was happened at midnight.
en: The accident happened at midnight.
passive.why_vi: happen là nội động từ (không có tân ngữ) → không có dạng bị động.

passive.wrong: Many trees have been cut down by people last year.
en: Many trees were cut down last year.
Many trees were cut down by people last year.
passive.why_vi: last year → quá khứ đơn bị động: were cut down; by people thường bỏ vì không cần thiết.

passive.wrong: The results will announced next week.
en: The results will be announced next week.

passive.wrong: Rice is grew in the Mekong Delta.
en: Rice is grown in the Mekong Delta.
passive.why_vi: is + V3: grow → grown (grew là quá khứ đơn).

passive.wrong: First, the tea leaves are pick by hand.
en: First, the tea leaves are picked by hand.
passive.why_vi: Mô tả quy trình (Task 1) dùng bị động hiện tại: are + picked.

verb-patterns.wrong: Many young people choose live in big cities.
en: Many young people choose to live in big cities.

verb-patterns.wrong: I suggest take the bus to save money.
en: I suggest taking the bus to save money.
verb-patterns.why_vi: suggest + V-ing (hoặc suggest that we take…).

en: She enjoys reading novels.

verb-patterns.wrong: They decided buying a new house.
en: They decided to buy a new house.

verb-patterns.wrong: He avoids to eat fast food.
en: He avoids eating fast food.

verb-patterns.wrong: Parents should encourage children read more.
en: Parents should encourage children to read more.

verb-patterns.wrong: I am interested in learn about other cultures.
en: I am interested in learning about other cultures.
verb-patterns.why_vi: Sau giới từ (in, at, of, about…) động từ ở dạng V-ing.

verb-patterns.wrong: The government wants reducing air pollution.
en: The government wants to reduce air pollution.

verb-patterns.wrong: My parents let me to go out at night.
en: My parents let me go out at night.
verb-patterns.why_vi: let / make + người + V nguyên mẫu (không có to).

verb-patterns.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
en: I look forward to hearing from you.
verb-patterns.why_vi: look forward to: to ở đây là giới từ → + V-ing.

word-order.wrong: The government should more invest in education.
en: The government should invest more in education.
word-order.why_vi: Trật tự: should + V + more (trạng từ đứng sau động từ).

word-order.wrong: This helps them make decision better.
en: This helps them make better decisions.
This helps them make a better decision.
word-order.why_vi: Tính từ đứng TRƯỚC danh từ: better decisions (decision đếm được → số nhiều hoặc thêm a).

word-order.wrong: I don't know where is the station.
en: I do not know where the station is.
word-order.why_vi: Câu hỏi gián tiếp giữ trật tự câu khẳng định: where + S + V.

en: She speaks English very well.
word-order.why_vi: Không chen trạng từ giữa động từ và tân ngữ: V + O + very well.

word-order.wrong: He has a car very expensive.
en: He has a very expensive car.
word-order.why_vi: Tính từ đứng trước danh từ: a very expensive car.

word-order.wrong: I go often to the gym.
en: I often go to the gym.
word-order.why_vi: Trạng từ tần suất đứng trước động từ thường: often go.

word-order.wrong: Can you tell me what time does the shop close?
en: Can you tell me what time the shop closes?
word-order.why_vi: Câu hỏi gián tiếp: không dùng trợ động từ does, chia động từ như câu thường: the shop closes.

word-order.wrong: Students should be given more time free.
en: Students should be given more free time.
word-order.why_vi: Tính từ free đứng trước danh từ time: more free time.

word-order.wrong: Not only it saves money but also it protects the environment.
en: Not only does it save money, but it also protects the environment.
It not only saves money but also protects the environment.
word-order.why_vi: Not only đứng đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ: Not only does it save…; hoặc để not only sau chủ ngữ.

word-order.wrong: Enough the city does not have hospitals.
en: The city does not have enough hospitals.
word-order.why_vi: enough đứng trước danh từ: enough hospitals.

comparison.wrong: Living in the city is more better than living in the countryside.
en: Living in the city is better than living in the countryside.
comparison.why_vi: better đã là so sánh hơn, không thêm more.

comparison.wrong: This exam is more easy than the last one.
en: This exam is easier than the last one.
comparison.why_vi: Tính từ ngắn / tận cùng -y: easy → easier.

comparison.wrong: Cars are more expensiver than motorbikes.
en: Cars are more expensive than motorbikes.
comparison.why_vi: Tính từ dài: more + adj, không thêm -er.

comparison.wrong: She is the most tall girl in my class.
en: She is the tallest girl in my class.
comparison.why_vi: Tính từ ngắn so sánh nhất: the + adj-est: the tallest.

comparison.wrong: Hanoi is not as big than Ho Chi Minh City.
en: Hanoi is not as big as Ho Chi Minh City.
comparison.why_vi: So sánh bằng: as + adj + as.

comparison.wrong: The number of cars was higher in 2020 than 2010.
en: The number of cars was higher in 2020 than in 2010.
comparison.why_vi: So sánh hai mốc thời gian cần lặp lại giới từ: than in 2010.

comparison.wrong: Online shopping is becoming more and more popularer.
en: Online shopping is becoming more and more popular.
Online shopping is becoming increasingly popular.
comparison.why_vi: popular là tính từ dài: more and more popular.

comparison.wrong: The more you practise, the better you will speaking.
en: The more you practise, the better you will speak.
The more you practice, the better you will speak.
comparison.why_vi: will + động từ nguyên mẫu: will speak.

comparison.wrong: This is the worse film I have ever seen.
en: This is the worst film I have ever seen.

comparison.wrong: Women spend twice as much time on housework than men.
en: Women spend twice as much time on housework as men.
comparison.why_vi: twice / three times as much … as (không dùng than).

contrast-cause.wrong: Although it was raining, but we went out.
en: Although it was raining, we went out.
It was raining, but we went out.
contrast-cause.why_vi: although và but không đi cùng nhau trong một câu — chỉ dùng một từ.

contrast-cause.wrong: Despite he was tired, he kept working.
en: Although he was tired, he kept working.
Despite being tired, he kept working.
Despite his tiredness, he kept working.
contrast-cause.why_vi: despite + danh từ / V-ing; muốn dùng mệnh đề (he was tired) thì phải dùng although.

contrast-cause.wrong: Because of the traffic was heavy, I was late.
en: Because the traffic was heavy, I was late.
Because of the heavy traffic, I was late.
contrast-cause.why_vi: because + mệnh đề; because of + danh từ / cụm danh từ.

contrast-cause.wrong: In spite of the rain, but the match continued.
en: In spite of the rain, the match continued.
Despite the rain, the match continued.
contrast-cause.why_vi: in spite of đã mang nghĩa “mặc dù”, không thêm but.

contrast-cause.wrong: Because she studied hard so she passed the exam.
en: Because she studied hard, she passed the exam.
She studied hard, so she passed the exam.
contrast-cause.why_vi: because và so không đi cùng nhau — chọn một.

contrast-cause.wrong: Despite of the high price, many people buy it.
en: Despite the high price, many people buy it.
In spite of the high price, many people buy it.
contrast-cause.why_vi: despite không có of (in spite of mới có of).

contrast-cause.wrong: Due to he lost his job, he moved back home.
en: Because he lost his job, he moved back home.
Due to losing his job, he moved back home.
Due to the loss of his job, he moved back home.
contrast-cause.why_vi: due to / owing to + danh từ / V-ing, không + mệnh đề.

contrast-cause.wrong: Although of the cost, the project is worth it.
en: Despite the cost, the project is worth it.
In spite of the cost, the project is worth it.
contrast-cause.why_vi: although không đi với of; trước danh từ dùng despite / in spite of.

contrast-cause.wrong: Even though the city is crowded, but many people move there.
en: Even though the city is crowded, many people move there.
contrast-cause.why_vi: even though giống although: không thêm but.

contrast-cause.wrong: Since of the bad weather, the flight was cancelled.
en: Because of the bad weather, the flight was cancelled.
Due to the bad weather, the flight was cancelled.
contrast-cause.why_vi: since (= because) + mệnh đề, không có since of. Trước danh từ dùng because of / due to.

linking.wrong: Firstly, public transport is cheap. Secondly, it is faster. Lastly, but it is safer.
en: Firstly, public transport is cheap. Secondly, it is faster. Lastly, it is safer.
linking.why_vi: Sau từ nối liệt kê không thêm but.

linking.wrong: However the cost is high, the benefits are greater.
en: Although the cost is high, the benefits are greater.
The cost is high. However, the benefits are greater.
linking.why_vi: however nối hai CÂU (sau dấu chấm hoặc chấm phẩy, có dấu phẩy theo sau), không nối hai mệnh đề như although.

linking.wrong: Furthermore, but online learning is cheaper.
en: Furthermore, online learning is cheaper.
linking.why_vi: Furthermore (hơn nữa) đã là từ nối thêm ý — không đặt but (nhưng) ngay sau nó.

linking.wrong: In addition, it also reduces pollution.
en: In addition, it reduces pollution.
It also reduces pollution.
linking.why_vi: in addition và also cùng nghĩa “thêm vào đó” — dùng một là đủ.

linking.wrong: For example, such as Japan and Korea.
en: For example, Japan and Korea.
For example, countries such as Japan and Korea.
linking.why_vi: for example và such as không đứng cạnh nhau; such as theo sau một danh từ chung (countries such as…).

linking.wrong: Moreover, many people they cannot afford a house.
en: Moreover, many people cannot afford a house.
linking.why_vi: Không lặp chủ ngữ: many people đã là chủ ngữ, bỏ they.

linking.wrong: In conclusion, in my opinion, I believe that education is important.
en: In conclusion, I believe that education is important.
In conclusion, in my opinion, education is important.
linking.why_vi: in my opinion và I believe trùng ý — giữ một.

linking.wrong: Therefore, so the government should act.
en: Therefore, the government should act.
So the government should act.
linking.why_vi: therefore và so cùng nghĩa “vì vậy” — dùng một.

linking.wrong: As a result of people use phones a lot, they sleep less.
en: Because people use phones a lot, they sleep less.
As a result of using phones a lot, people sleep less.
People use phones a lot. As a result, they sleep less.
linking.why_vi: as a result of + danh từ / V-ing, không + mệnh đề. Muốn dùng mệnh đề: because + S + V, hoặc tách câu rồi dùng As a result, ở đầu câu sau.

en: However, there are some disadvantages.
Nevertheless, there are some disadvantages.
linking.why_vi: despite phải có danh từ theo sau; đầu câu để chuyển ý đối lập dùng However, / Nevertheless,.

relative.wrong: The man which lives next door is a doctor.
en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The man that lives next door is a doctor.
relative.why_vi: Chỉ người dùng who / that, không dùng which.

relative.wrong: This is the book who I told you about.
en: This is the book which I told you about.
This is the book that I told you about.
This is the book I told you about.
relative.why_vi: Chỉ vật dùng which / that (hoặc bỏ đại từ khi nó làm tân ngữ).

relative.wrong: The city where I visited last year is very beautiful.
en: The city which I visited last year is very beautiful.
The city that I visited last year is very beautiful.
The city I visited last year is very beautiful.
relative.why_vi: visit cần tân ngữ trực tiếp → dùng which / that. where chỉ dùng khi sau nó là mệnh đề đủ (the city where I live).

relative.wrong: Students who they study hard usually succeed.
en: Students who study hard usually succeed.
relative.why_vi: who đã thay cho chủ ngữ — bỏ they.

relative.wrong: My mother, that is a nurse, works at night.
en: My mother, who is a nurse, works at night.
relative.why_vi: Mệnh đề không xác định (có dấu phẩy) không dùng that → who.

relative.wrong: The girl whose her father is a pilot sits next to me.
en: The girl whose father is a pilot sits next to me.
relative.why_vi: whose đã mang nghĩa sở hữu “của cô ấy” — bỏ her.

relative.wrong: People who lives in cities often feel stressed.
en: People who live in cities often feel stressed.
relative.why_vi: Động từ trong mệnh đề quan hệ chia theo people (số nhiều) → live.

relative.wrong: That is the reason which I chose this job.
en: That is the reason why I chose this job.
That is the reason I chose this job.

relative.wrong: The day when I met her it was very cold.
en: The day when I met her was very cold.
The day I met her was very cold.
relative.why_vi: Chủ ngữ là the day (when I met her chỉ bổ nghĩa) → không thêm it.

relative.wrong: I have a friend who he can speak four languages.
en: I have a friend who can speak four languages.
relative.why_vi: Bỏ he: who đã làm chủ ngữ của mệnh đề.

conditionals.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
conditionals.why_vi: Loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, S + will + V. Không dùng will sau if.

conditionals.wrong: If I am rich, I would travel around the world.
en: If I were rich, I would travel around the world.
conditionals.why_vi: Loại 2 (không có thật ở hiện tại): If + quá khứ đơn (were cho mọi ngôi), would + V.

conditionals.wrong: If I had more time, I will learn the piano.
en: If I had more time, I would learn the piano.
conditionals.why_vi: Loại 2: vế chính dùng would, không dùng will.

conditionals.wrong: If you heat ice, it melt.
en: If you heat ice, it melts.
conditionals.why_vi: Loại 0 (sự thật): hai vế đều hiện tại đơn; it → melts.

conditionals.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
en: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you do not hurry, you will miss the bus.
conditionals.why_vi: unless = if not: không thêm don't nữa.

conditionals.wrong: If the government invests more, traffic would improve.
en: If the government invests more, traffic will improve.
If the government invested more, traffic would improve.
conditionals.why_vi: Không trộn loại 1 và loại 2: invests → will; invested → would.

conditionals.wrong: If I was you, I would accept the offer.
en: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
conditionals.why_vi: Câu khuyên “nếu tôi là bạn” dùng If I were you.

conditionals.wrong: If people would recycle more, there would be less waste.
en: If people recycled more, there would be less waste.
conditionals.why_vi: Không dùng would ở vế if: If + quá khứ đơn (recycled).

conditionals.wrong: If you will study harder, you will pass.
en: If you study harder, you will pass.
conditionals.why_vi: Sau if dùng hiện tại đơn, không dùng will.

conditionals.wrong: What would you do if you win the lottery?
en: What would you do if you won the lottery?
conditionals.why_vi: Loại 2: would ở vế chính thì vế if dùng quá khứ đơn: won.

conditionals-3.wrong: If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
conditionals-3.why_vi: Loại 3 (trái với quá khứ): If + had V3, would have + V3.

conditionals-3.wrong: If she has left earlier, she would have caught the train.
en: If she had left earlier, she would have caught the train.
conditionals-3.why_vi: Vế if của loại 3 dùng had + V3.

conditionals-3.wrong: If they had known, they would have came.
en: If they had known, they would have come.
conditionals-3.why_vi: would have + V3: come → come (came là quá khứ đơn).

conditionals-3.wrong: If it didn't rain yesterday, we would have gone out.
en: If it had not rained yesterday, we would have gone out.

conditionals-3.wrong: We would had won if he had scored.
en: We would have won if he had scored.

conditionals-3.wrong: If the government had acted sooner, fewer people would lose their jobs.
en: If the government had acted sooner, fewer people would have lost their jobs.
conditionals-3.why_vi: Kết quả trong quá khứ: would have lost.

conditionals-3.wrong: If I would have known, I would have helped you.
en: If I had known, I would have helped you.
conditionals-3.why_vi: Không dùng would have ở vế if: If I had known.

conditionals-3.wrong: Had I knew about the meeting, I would have attended.
en: Had I known about the meeting, I would have attended.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
conditionals-3.why_vi: Đảo ngữ loại 3: Had + S + V3 (known).

conditionals-3.wrong: If he had took the medicine, he would have recovered faster.
en: If he had taken the medicine, he would have recovered faster.

conditionals-3.wrong: If you had told me, I could helped you.
en: If you had told me, I could have helped you.
conditionals-3.why_vi: could / might cũng cần have + V3 ở loại 3: could have helped.

modals.wrong: You should to see a doctor.
en: You should see a doctor.
modals.why_vi: Sau should / must / can / may không có to.

en: She can speak three languages.
modals.why_vi: Động từ khuyết thiếu + V nguyên mẫu: speak.

en: Students must wear uniforms.
modals.why_vi: must + V nguyên mẫu, không phải V-ing.

en: We must not smoke here.
We mustn't smoke here.
modals.why_vi: Phủ định của must là must not / mustn't (cấm).

modals.wrong: He musts finish the report today.
en: He must finish the report today.
modals.why_vi: Động từ khuyết thiếu không thêm -s theo chủ ngữ.

modals.wrong: Can you to open the window, please?
en: Can you open the window, please?
Could you open the window, please?
modals.why_vi: Can + S + V nguyên mẫu, không có to.

modals.wrong: You don't have to cheat in the exam.
en: You must not cheat in the exam.
You mustn't cheat in the exam.
modals.why_vi: don't have to = không cần phải; muốn nói “cấm” dùng must not.

modals.wrong: The government should invests in schools.
en: The government should invest in schools.
It might rain this afternoon.

modals.wrong: Yesterday I must stay at home because I was ill.
en: Yesterday I had to stay at home because I was ill.
I had to stay at home yesterday because I was ill.
modals.why_vi: must không có dạng quá khứ → dùng had to.

trends.wrong: The number of tourists increased sharp in 2010.
en: The number of tourists increased sharply in 2010.
trends.why_vi: Động từ (increased) đi với trạng từ: sharply.

trends.wrong: There was a dramatically rise in sales.
en: There was a dramatic rise in sales.
trends.why_vi: Danh từ (a rise) đi với tính từ: dramatic.

en: Sales rose from 20% to 35%.

trends.wrong: The price fell by 50 dollars at 2015.
en: The price fell by 50 dollars in 2015.

trends.wrong: The figure reached at a peak of 80% in 2018.
en: The figure reached a peak of 80% in 2018.
The figure peaked at 80% in 2018.
trends.why_vi: reach + tân ngữ trực tiếp (không có at); hoặc peak at.

trends.wrong: Unemployment remained stably over the period.
en: Unemployment remained stable over the period.

trends.wrong: The percentage of women in work has grew steadily.
en: The percentage of women in work has grown steadily.

trends.wrong: There was a slight decrease of the number of visitors.
en: There was a slight decrease in the number of visitors.
trends.why_vi: an increase / a decrease + in + thứ thay đổi; by + mức thay đổi.

trends.wrong: The rate of car ownership doubled from 2000 and 2020.
en: The rate of car ownership doubled between 2000 and 2020.
The rate of car ownership doubled from 2000 to 2020.
trends.why_vi: between … and … hoặc from … to …, không trộn from … and.

trends.wrong: Overall, the number of students who use bicycles are decreased.
en: Overall, the number of students who use bicycles decreased.
Overall, the number of students who use bicycles has decreased.
trends.why_vi: decrease là nội động từ → không dùng bị động; chủ ngữ the number (số ít).
